description: Register an owned public HTTPS site for passive Watchtower monitoring. Ask for the exact host and confirmation of authority. Return the same target ID on retries. Show the returned DNS TXT name and value to the customer for entry at their DNS provider. Does not modify DNS, start monitoring or start a scan.

authorized.description: Set only after the customer explicitly confirms they own or are authorized to manage this domain.

name.description: A display name for this site.

url.description: Exact public HTTPS origin, such as https://status.example.com.

name: vulkill_watchtower_register_target
